name: Bloom of the Heavens
objectiveText: Bring Nord'el to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore. You recall Sylessa mentioning a boat in Menethil Harbor can take you there. Nord'el (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body:
Looking towards the dock from Menethil Harbor, [b]take the boat to your right[/b]. You may talk to [npc=12657] there to confirm where the boat will take you.

Solid bit of XP from this quick quest chain--[i]especially if you do it en route to Blackfathom Deeps, requiring you to take the boat anyways[/i]... [b]3550[/b] total, and [b]+150[/b] Darnassus reputation.
